librispeech.description: Transcribe read English audiobooks. The clean and other test splits are reported separately.
librispeech.assessment: Word error rate on the specified split; lower is better.
librispeech.date_note: The Kaldi recipe documents the English corpus by this date; this is not a release date for Multilingual LibriSpeech.

docvqa.description: Read a document page to answer a question grounded in its text and layout.
docvqa.input: Document page image and natural-language question
docvqa.output: Short answer extracted from the document
docvqa.assessment: Average Normalized Levenshtein Similarity against reference answers
docvqa.date_note: Availability of the first training set; the test set followed on April 20.

chartqa.description: Read plotted values and reason across them to answer questions about a chart.
chartqa.assessment: Answer accuracy with tolerance for numerical responses

scienceqa.description: Solve school-level science questions; the dataset includes explanations as well as answer choices.
scienceqa.input: Science question, choices and optional image or context
scienceqa.output: Selected answer; explanations can also be generated
scienceqa.assessment: Choice accuracy; explanation quality evaluated separately
scienceqa.first_author_affil: University of California, Los Angeles and Allen Institute for AI

pope.description: Probe whether a vision-language model claims an object is present when it is absent from the image.
pope.assessment: Accuracy, precision, recall, F1 and yes-answer rate
pope.first_author_affil: Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China; Beijing Key Laboratory of Big Data Management and Analysis Methods

mme.description: Ask paired yes/no questions about each image to test visual recognition and reasoning.
mme.output: Yes or no for each question
mme.assessment: Per-question accuracy plus accuracy requiring both answers correct

mmbench.description: Answer image-based multiple-choice questions; rotating answer choices tests consistency.
mmbench.input: Image, question and rotating multiple-choice options
mmbench.assessment: Correct across every rotation in CircularEval

mathvista.description: Combine a diagram, chart or other visual with mathematical reasoning to solve a question.
mathvista.input: Visual math problem and optional answer choices
mathvista.assessment: Extracted answer normalized and matched to reference

mmmu.description: Interpret discipline-specific visuals such as diagrams and charts to solve college-level problems.
mmmu.input: College-level subject question and associated visuals
mmmu.assessment: Choice accuracy or rule-based open-answer matching
mmmu.date_note: First arXiv submission (v1, UTC). Stars mark core contributors, not a guarantee of equal first authorship.

mvbench.description: Choose the answer to questions designed to require interpretation of events over time, not just a single frame.
mvbench.input: Video clip and multiple-choice temporal question
mvbench.first_author_affil: Shenzhen Institute of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences; University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; and Shanghai AI Laboratory

ocrbench.description: Read text in images, answer text-dependent questions and extract document information. This is OCRBench, not OCRBench v2.
ocrbench.input: An image and a question or recognition instruction
ocrbench.assessment: Count answers accepted by the official evaluator across its task categories.
ocrbench.date_note: The authors committed the named OCRBench test questions by this date. The earlier preprint also evaluated individual OCR datasets.

video-mme.description: Answer questions about short through hour-long videos, with or without subtitles and audio.
video-mme.input: Video and multiple-choice question; optional audio or subtitles
video-mme.assessment: Answer accuracy, broken down by video duration

lifeeval.description: Answer time-aligned questions about a person’s ongoing activities in first-person video.
lifeeval.assessment: Answers scored against annotated choices, by capability
lifeeval.date_note: v1 preprint. Unrelated to OpenAI LifeVal.
lifeeval.first_author_affil: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory; Shanghai Jiao Tong University

benchcad.description: Reconstruct mechanical parts in code and answer image or code questions about their geometry.
benchcad.input: CAD renders, part specifications or CAD code, by track
benchcad.output: An executable design or task-specific answer
benchcad.assessment: Executed solids are compared geometrically; numeric questions use answer accuracy.

benchcad-2-0.description: Produce parts and assemblies from drawings or images, and infer circuit connectivity from rendered boards.
benchcad-2-0.input: Engineering drawings, rendered components or PCB images
benchcad-2-0.output: An executable design or task-specific answer
benchcad-2-0.assessment: Task-specific comparisons on the 100-case Core split; the public sample is not the reportable Core score.

benchcad-2-1.description: Complete the Core hardware engineering tasks with a revised standard harness, budget and cross-round reasoning.
benchcad-2-1.input: Core hardware-design briefs and associated images
benchcad-2-1.output: An executable design or task-specific answer
benchcad-2-1.assessment: Mean Core score under the 2.1 budget and verifier. Standard and customized harnesses are reported separately.

vision-arena.input: The same image and prompt for two models.
vision-arena.assessment: Human head-to-head preferences determine the vision ranking; the automated VisionArena-Bench subset is distinct.

video-arena.description: Reason about game recordings with known state.
video-arena.input: A video and a task query.
video-arena.output: A prediction about scene state or spatiotemporal events.
video-arena.assessment: Task-specific checks use ground truth derived from the game environment.
